cards.title: AI rebounds; rates still constrain
cards.question: Is this a new uptrend or relief after Tuesday's selloff?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nov 10 S&P −0.38%, Nasdaq −0.74%; hot CPI drove 10Y yields near 5%. Nov 11 Nasdaq futures rebounded ~1.9%. TEST: sustained cash-session breadth and lower yields, not premarket alone.
cards.prompt: Explain the Nov 10 inflation shock and Nov 11 AI premarket rebound, distinguishing evidence from a durable regime change.

cards.title: A rebound needs wider participation
cards.question: What would prove AI strength is broadening?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: Nov 10 equal-weight S&P held up better than cap-weight; NVDA fell ~5.5%. WATCH: RSP/SPY, SOXX, IWM and credit. A tech-only bounce with weak breadth is less convincing.
cards.prompt: Analyze whether semiconductor and market breadth confirm the Nov 11 premarket rebound.

cards.title: TSMC demand is real; returns still matter
cards.question: What does strong foundry revenue prove—and not prove?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: TSMC reported October revenue growth of ~59.7% YoY. INFERENCE: advanced-node demand remains robust. NOT PROVEN: every AI supplier's margin or data-center return on capital.
cards.prompt: Explain how TSMC October 2026 sales inform AI semiconductor demand, and where the inference stops.

cards.title: Backlogs must become cash flow
cards.question: When do AI infrastructure commitments become durable earnings?
cards.selfCheck: FACT: CoreWeave's raised outlook lifted AI infrastructure shares premarket. HYPOTHESIS: compute demand can support optics, memory and power suppliers. TEST: revenue conversion, financing cost, utilization and margins.
cards.prompt: Analyze delayed AI infrastructure demand conversion into earnings for memory, optical and power suppliers.

cards.title: Watch the post-CPI rate test
cards.question: Which upcoming proof points can change AI valuations?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH: next bond-market session after Veterans Day, upcoming AI earnings, and quarterly capex guidance. SCENARIO: strong orders with lower yields help multiples; high yields or weaker returns compress them.
cards.prompt: Build a forward 1–12 month catalyst map for AI semiconductors after Nov 10 2026 CPI and the Nov 11 Veterans Day bond-market closure.

cards.title: Demand strength ≠ stock-price safety
cards.question: What would make this rebound investable rather than chaseable?
cards.selfCheck: THESIS: AI demand is resilient but valuation/rate risk persists. REQUIRE: earnings upgrades, broad chip participation and stable credit. REJECT: renewed NVDA-led distribution, falling orders or persistent 5% yields.
cards.prompt: Stress-test the Nov 11 2026 AI semiconductor rebound thesis with bullish and bearish evidence and clear invalidation triggers.
